assumptions: Independent targets from zero materials, using the supplied machines and explicitly costed local additions. Targets are not cumulative.
Primitive Filtration and its prerequisites researched before arrival. No imported materials. Vents stay at 100 percent yield.
Only named crude filtration recipes use mean independent yields. This is an average-yield work estimate, not an exact batch or completion-time expectation.
Continuous electricity, no modules, beacons or research productivity. Half-power duty is a sensitivity case, not measured lightning availability.
Shared machine time allows free recipe changes. Fractional crafts, no dependency delays, placement, transport or player time. Results are work lower bounds.
Eight small and two medium starter tanks bound final liquid surplus, not peak intermediate volume. Solid surplus is retained without a chest-capacity constraint and is reported.
Liquid voiding is forbidden. Native compatible gas disposal is permitted. Research triggers are assumed met; checkpoint actions are not timed.
Research costs subtract the entrance closure. Production uses the explicit boundary technology closure throughout. Research time uses one lab and overlaps production optimistically.
One probe android can hand craft solid recipes in its resolved categories, at base speed. Equipment and research speed bonuses are excluded.

Survey cases use nearest-three usable vent means at the origin from fulgora-vent-coverage: seed 42 and seed 2 on 2.1.19. These bracket twelve sampled seeds, not all maps or actual landing sites. Resource depletion is omitted.

Extractor research recipes are available from time zero in this optimistic lower bound, but all required science production and one-lab work are counted. This does not schedule research unlocks or new-machine deployment.

One locally built medium assembler is used throughout this lower bound; its construction is included in each target. The separate arrival-stage target proves its materials are available before the extractor batch.
A medium furnace 2 and barrel pump 1 are also built locally and their costs are included; this lower bound permits their use before construction and research finish.
One locally built compressor is included in construction cost and usable throughout the lower-bound solve.
